summary: Sub-constructor for an unknown object (contextually associated with a DirectX pixel-shader path). Calls RenderBufferVertexAllocator to allocate render-buffer/vertex data, then installs a vtable pointer by storing the address of global off_5ADE1C into the object's first dword, and returns the object pointer.

operations.description: Call RenderBufferVertexAllocator(a2, a3) to allocate render-buffer/vertex data for the object.
Install the vtable: store the address of global off_5ADE1C into *a1 at offset 0x0.
Return the constructed object pointer a1.

unresolved: Class identity of the constructed object is unknown; the off_5ADE1C vtable is only loosely tied to a pixel-shader path by prior analysis.
Semantics of arguments a2 and a3 passed through to RenderBufferVertexAllocator are unresolved.
The __userpurge calling convention with a2 sourced from EBP and a3 from the stack is unusual and its effect on the callee contract is unresolved.
